items.context: The Mayor wants to know if you'll pull his tooth.
items.reason: While 'mayor' in Spanish means 'older,' the context quickly makes it clear this is a title of authority. The Mayor sends a bill 'to you or the town,' confirming political role. Initial confusion possible but context resolves it within the first exchange.
